description: [READ] Get the tournament leaderboard for the Coordination Game. Shows top players ranked by score (wins^2 / total_games). Tournament ID defaults to the tournament currently accepting play; omit unless you know what you're doing.

limit.description: Maximum number of entries to return (default 20, max 100).

tournament_id.description: Tournament ID to get leaderboard for. Defaults to the tournament currently accepting play (chain-registry::active_tournament_id); omit unless you know what you're doing.

name: game_get_leaderboard
